term: causation of a subject's esse by its essential principles (q.3 a.4)
definition: The model's essentialPrinciplesCauseEsse x represents the disputed causal alternative in q.3 a.4: the constitutive principles of the subject's essence efficiently causing that very subject's esse. It is not equivalent to the subject having an intrinsic conceptual or noncausal reason for a necessary truth.
